top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The kitchen cabinet beneath the sink was observed to have cleaning chemicals inside within children's reach. The bathroom was also observed to have multiple chemicals along the edge of the tub and along the kitchen sink.    ** The caregiver removed the chemicals and placed them in a cabinet out of children's reach.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was determined that the staff was aware of a child receiving medical attention after sustaining an injury while in care, but did not report to Child Care Licensing within two days of becoming notified.

top_violation_types.title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The incident report was not signed by the parent.
